title: Wheatfield Kitchen · Country kitchen in Malmesbury
text: Wheatfield Kitchen. Home, Menu, Visit. Country cooking from the Swartland's own farms. Lunch Tuesday to Sunday, 12:00 to 15:00. Dinner Thursday to Saturday. Book a table. Lunch Tuesday to Sunday. Dinner Thursday to Saturday. Sixty seats, on the stoep too. Wheelchair access. A country kitchen in Malmesbury: lunch from Tuesday to Sunday, dinner from Thursday to Saturday, sixty seats inside and on the stoep. The menu. Book a table. Menu: from the kitchen, country cooking from the Swartland's own farms. The kitchen can leave out gluten or dairy on most dishes, if you ask when you book. Starters: snoek pâté R85, with farm bread and apricot jam. Beetroot and feta salad R80, roasted beetroot, rocket and walnuts. Soup of the day R70, with farm bread. Mains: the Sunday roast R165, on Sundays, with roast potatoes and gravy. Lamb shank R185, slow-cooked, on mash. Chicken pie R125, with a green salad. Bobotie R140, with yellow rice and chutney. Vegetable bake R115, vegetarian. Puddings: malva pudding R65, with custard. Melktert R55, with cinnamon. Ice cream R45, with chocolate sauce. For the children: a children's menu, each dish R75: fish and chips, chicken strips and chips, macaroni cheese. Wine: wines from the Swartland and the Riebeek Valley, by the glass or the bottle. Corkage R60. Not drinking? Rooibos iced tea R35, and filter coffee R30. Visit: when we're open, Tuesday to Sunday, lunch 12:00 to 15:00, and dinner 18:00 to 21:30 from Thursday to Saturday. Closed Mondays. Find us: sixty seats inside and on the stoep, wheelchair access, and parking behind the restaurant. Book a table: ask in the chat and the owner confirms your table. Groups of more than twelve, and private functions, by arrangement with the owner.
